name: Snow and Stories
tagline: Four full Tokyo days of anime and one big car day, a fast Kansai part from one base, then 7 nights in Hokkaido with ski-in Niseko, the drift course and Sapporo.
summary: Tokyo 4 nights: Akihabara, Ikebukuro, Nakano and a SHELTER live show, the Girls Band Cry walk in Kawasaki, and one rental-car day for Fuji, the Hakone passes and Daikoku. Then the Nozomi to Osaka for 3 nights from one Namba hotel: the Nara hill fire (Sat 23), a Kyoto day with the Sabbat places, and the Suzuka EV kart (Mon 25). On Jan 26 you fly to New Chitose and sleep 4 nights at a ski-in hotel at Niseko Annupuri, where Pegasis teaches Aoki and drives the Rusutsu snow course. The last 3 nights are in Sapporo, with Asahiyama's penguins. You travel together every day, every meal is planned, and there are only 4 hotels in 14 nights.

who.pegasis: IN (23 of your 25 wants): Daikoku with you driving (Thu night, no guide), Hakone Turnpike, Taikanzan, Otome Pass, Gotemba outlets (lunch and a short shopping stop), free City Hall view, Narita bus instead of N'EX, Omoide Yokocho (night 1), SHELTER with a live show, Nakano, Radio Kaikan, Ikebukuro goods, Maidreamin (Shibuya and Sapporo), Nara hill fire, Suzuka EV kart, Rusutsu drift (you drive the 15:00 course, after the licence email), Niseko Grand Hirafu (a full day there together), Asahiyama penguins, Daruma, Moiwa, GARAKU. OUT: Onuma (on the Hakodate side, not on this route), the Tokaido car road west (this plan takes the Shinkansen; only Suzuka is kept), and Isetan half-price food (the food hall closes at 20:00 and you are never in Shinjuku together before then). Osaka Castle (your maybe) is out: on the Kyoto day you go with Aoki to Fushimi Inari and Kinkakuji, which you marked not interested, because they are his wants and there is no split. Also for Aoki: 20 minutes at the Suga stairs and dinner in Yokohama Chinatown. Gear: you bring your own thick winter clothes (no clothes shopping); ski rental with ski wear at Rhythm; goggles and ski gloves bought in the Rhythm shop (they cannot be rented); one medium suitcase from Don Quijote in Shinjuku on day 2, which travels with you (checked bag on Jetstar and on the flight home). 4 laundry nights, all in the hotels.
who.aoki: IN: Omoide Yokocho, Daikoku (and Tatsumi PA if open), Lake Kawaguchi, the Eva road through Sengokuhara to Lake Ashi, Yokohama Chinatown (Cup Noodles Museum is out: it closes 18:00), Suga stairs, Shimokitazawa, SHELTER live show, Nakano, Akihabara ZEST and Radio Kaikan, Ikebukuro goods, used goods, free City Hall view, Girls Band Cry Tokyo Station dome, Hachiko and the Kawasaki walk (Miharashi, Lazona, East Exit plaza, Marufuku, CLUB CITTA') with the stamp book (bought in Kawasaki; the online shop does not ship abroad), Shibuya Sky before 15:00, Nintendo/Pokémon Shibuya, maid café, Don Quijote coupon, Nara fire, Fushimi Inari in the early morning, Kinkakuji, Sabbat of the Witch in Kyoto, Namba food, Den Den Town, Liberty Walk, Suzuka, Niseko first ski days (Pegasis teaches you on the Family course and the Dream No.1 Quad; no ski school, no lessons), Niseko Grand Hirafu (a full day together), Rusutsu drift ride (rear seat in Pegasis's course), Daruma, Moiwa. For Pegasis you also join Gotemba outlets (lunch and 40 minutes of shops) and Lake Shikotsu is only for Pegasis after your flight. OUT: Enoshima/Slam Dunk, Yuru Camp Motosu and the Hanz villa (only one car day, no Fuji night), Fujiten ski (Hokkaido snow is better), Fuji Motorsports Museum and Nissan Crossing (Pegasis not interested), Toyota day in Nagoya, the Kobe and Grand Front Sabbat places (the Kansai part is fast), Cape Kamui (winter path closed), Aokana/Goto (far). No onsen bathing is planned for either of you; the hotels have a bath in the room.

Turnpike ¥900, fuel, parking ≈ ¥18,000, Nozomi ≈ ¥14,700, Kansai trains incl. Suzuka (Kintetsu ¥3,510 each way), Kyoto buses and Liberty Walk ≈ ¥16,000, Rapi:t ¥1,670, Jetstar ¥7,510, Hokkaido 4WD 4 days + fuel ≈ ¥27,000 each, JR Asahikawa ¥10,880, airport train ¥1,230). Checked bags: Aoki ≈ ¥3,000–5,000 on Spring Airlines and both ≈ ¥2,500 each on Jetstar; Pegasis adds ¥2,520 for the Shikotsu bus.
cost.hotels: ≈ ¥259,000 per person (Super Hotel Shinjuku 4 n ¥34,900; Dormy Inn Namba ANNEX 3 n ≈ ¥40,000; Niseko Northern Resort 4 n with dinner + breakfast ¥141,300 on the official site's 90-day early-bird plan + Niseko/Hokkaido accommodation tax ≈ ¥4,000 (estimate); Route-Inn Sapporo 3 n ¥39,200).
cost.activities: Pegasis ≈ ¥124,000 (ski rental 3 days with wear ≈ ¥39,000 with the online discount, lifts ≈ ¥32,000 (Annupuri day ¥7,800, Rusutsu 5 h online ¥11,600, Hirafu + Hanazono ¥12,500), Rusutsu 30-min Introduction drive ¥31,000, Suzuka, Shibuya Sky, SHELTER, maid cafés, temples, Moiwa, zoo, Shikotsu) · Aoki ≈ ¥90,000 (same rental, lifts ≈ ¥22,000–26,000, drift rear seat ¥10,000, the rest similar; no ski lessons)
cost.total: Pegasis ≈ ¥495,000 + food ≈ ¥60,000 + goggles and gloves ≈ ¥9,000–25,000 + suitcase ≈ ¥5,000–10,000 · Aoki ≈ ¥465,000 + food ≈ ¥60,000 (+ goggles and gloves if he has none). Food ≈ ¥60,000 per person is for about 30 meals out (every meal is a stop in the days); free breakfasts at Super Hotel (4) and Route-Inn (3), Niseko breakfasts and dinners (4 + 4) in the hotel price. Excl. international flights

Home: Air Canada AC 54 New Chitose 19:35 Tue Feb 2 → Vancouver (new route from Dec 17, 2026; Tue/Fri/Sun), then Air Canada Vancouver → Toronto 19:57 same day (the Feb 2027 number is not published yet; today AC 112 fits). Choose a fare with 1 checked bag for the suitcase home (not checked here; if a fee applies, budget about CA$100).

Aoki: in: Spring Airlines 9C 6217 Shanghai Pudong 15:00 → Narita Terminal 3 18:40 Tue Jan 19 (Google Flights, Sep 26, 2026: ¥32,840 base fare with a small cabin bag only: choose a fare with a checked bag, about ¥3,000–5,000 more). Home: Spring Airlines 9C 8792 New Chitose 13:50 → Shanghai Pudong 17:00 Tue Feb 2, nonstop (Tue/Sat only; ¥83,340, Chinese New Year prices). Book early.

Osaka → Hokkaido: Jetstar Japan GK 153, Kansai 10:05 → New Chitose 12:05, Tue Jan 26 (Sep 2026 schedule; Google Flights, Sep 26, 2026: ¥7,510 for the morning flight; + a checked bag each, about ¥2,500). Backup: Peach Kansai 09:15 → 11:10 (¥10,150).

bookFirst.what: Toyota Rent a Car, both cars: (1) Shinjuku-sanchome, Thu Jan 21 08:00 → Fri Jan 22 08:00, compact with studless tyres (¥2,200/24 h) + ETC card (¥550); (2) New Chitose Airport Poplar → Sapporo-ekimae, Jan 26 13:00 → Jan 30 about 13:15, 4WD
bookFirst.why: book NOW (late Sep 2026): Toyota takes bookings 6 months ahead and cancelling is free up to 7 days before pick-up. Tokyo shops have few studless cars: after booking, phone the Shinjuku-sanchome shop (03-3341-2603) to confirm a studless car. 4WD cars at CTS sell out in the ski season.

bookFirst.what: Niseko Northern Resort An'nupuri, Jan 26–30, deluxe twin (or ask for the standard twin with separate beds), dinner + breakfast, on the official site (90-day early-bird plan, ¥282,600 for 2)
bookFirst.why: book NOW, by Oct 28 at the latest (90-day early-bird ends): the official site showed '1 room left' on Sep 26 and Niseko is almost full for late January. Jalan was ¥303,808 for the same room.

bookFirst.what: Rusutsu snow drift: email activity@rusutsu.co.jp (tel 0136-46-3332) now to ask if Pegasis's 1-year licence + IDP is accepted; then book the Thu Jan 28 15:00 Introduction course (¥31,000, Aoki in the rear seat ¥10,000)
bookFirst.why: email NOW (the answer decides if Pegasis drives or you both take the ¥17,000-per-person pro ride); book after the answer and by early January. A 10% cancellation fee applies from the moment of booking (50% from the day before).

bookFirst.what: All flights: Pegasis's open-jaw (with 1 checked bag home), Aoki's Spring Airlines both ways with a checked bag, Jetstar KIX → CTS on Jan 26 with a checked bag for each of you
bookFirst.why: book by Oct 15, because Chinese New Year pushes Aoki's Feb 2 fare up and the ¥7,510 Jetstar fare will not last.

bookFirst.what: Hotels: Super Hotel Shinjuku Kabukicho (Jan 19–23), Dormy Inn PREMIUM Namba ANNEX (Jan 23–26, free-cancellation rate), Route-Inn Sapporo Ekimae Kitaguchi (Jan 30–Feb 2)
bookFirst.why: book by Oct 15, because the Nara fire Saturday fills Osaka and the Sapporo twin plans showed '1 room left'. In November, check the official Nara page for the Jan 23 hill-fire date before the free cancellation ends.

bookFirst.what: Rhythm ski rental for both (3 days Jan 27–29, skis + boots + poles + helmet + jacket + pants), pick-up at Rhythm Hirafu on Wed Jan 27 morning, return Fri Jan 29 about 15:40 (goggles and gloves cannot be rented: buy them in the shop)
bookFirst.why: book online by Oct 31, 2026: the 10% online discount (code shown on the Rhythm site) ends that day.

bookFirst.what: Suzuka EV kart (Mon Jan 25, Asoview) and SHELTER show ticket (Wed Jan 20)
bookFirst.why: on Dec 1, 2026 the January kart times come out (plan for about 12:30, the karts run only about 12:00–13:15); book at once. The SHELTER January list also comes out in December: if Jan 20 has no show, swap day 2 and day 4.

bookFirst.what: Shibuya Sky web ticket, Fri Jan 22, 14:40 slot
bookFirst.why: book on Jan 8, 2027 (tickets open 2 weeks ahead): the before-15:00 slots are cheaper (¥2,700) and sell out.

places.ja: 成田国際空港
places.blurb: Both of you land here on Tue Jan 19. Pegasis lands first (WestJet, Terminal 1, 16:30) and waits for Aoki at Terminal 3, where Spring Airlines lands at 18:40. You take the airport bus to Tokyo together.

info.label: Aoki lands
info.value: 18:40, Spring Airlines 9C 6217 from Shanghai Pudong, Terminal 3

info.label: To Tokyo
info.value: Airport Bus TYO-NRT, Terminal 3 19:40 → Tokyo Station 20:48, ¥1,500 (buses every 10 min; from Terminal 1 they leave 20 min earlier)

tips: A free shuttle bus runs between the terminals (T1 → T3 about 15 min).
Pegasis: while you wait, buy two Welcome Suica cards and eat at Matsuya (T3 food court, 24 h).
The ¥1,500 bus needs no booking. Late-night buses cost ¥3,000, so take one before about 22:00.

places.ja: 松屋 成田空港第3ターミナル店
places.blurb: A 24-hour beef-bowl shop in the Terminal 3 food court, where Aoki's Spring Airlines flight arrives. Pegasis eats here while he waits for Aoki.
tips: Order at the ticket machine (English menu).
Terminal 3 arrivals is one floor down: meet Aoki at the exit from customs.

places.ja: 東京駅 丸の内南口ドーム
places.blurb: The round brick hall where Nina arrives in Tokyo in Girls Band Cry episode 1. The airport bus stops at Tokyo Station, so it costs only 10 minutes.

info.label: From the bus stop
info.value: Walk through the station to the Marunouchi side, 5–8 min

tips: Look up at the dome ceiling: eagles and the Chinese zodiac animals.

places.ja: スーパーホテル新宿歌舞伎町
places.blurb: A good-value business hotel in Kabukicho, 7 minutes from Shinjuku Station, with a free breakfast buffet. You sleep here 4 nights, Jan 19–22.

info.label: Room
info.value: Economy twin (two 90 cm beds) with breakfast

info.label: Price
info.value: ¥69,800 for 4 nights, 2 people (Jalan, vacancy seen Sep 26, 2026) = about ¥34,900 per person

info.label: Laundry
info.value: Coin laundry in the hotel (washer ¥100, dryer free)

tips: Book on Jalan or the official site with the free Smart Membership: about ¥500 back per night.
The room is small: keep the suitcases closed under the beds.
Kabukicho is noisy at night: ask for a high floor.

places.ja: 立呑み晩杯屋 新宿思い出横丁
places.blurb: A cheap standing bar in Omoide Yokocho: small plates of yakitori-style food, stews and fried things from about ¥150, drinks from about ¥300. A good first late dinner in the yakitori alley.
tips: It closes at 23:00: order the food first.
If it is full, the yakitori bars next to it are open to about midnight (seat charge ¥300–500).

places.ja: 須賀神社（男坂）
places.blurb: The red-railed stairs from the last scene of Your Name. Early morning is quiet.
tips: Stand at the bottom and shoot up the stairs for the film angle.
It is a residential street: keep your voice low.

places.en: Tokyo Metropolitan Government Building, free observatory
places.ja: 東京都庁 展望室
places.blurb: A free deck 202 m above Nishi-Shinjuku. On clear winter mornings you see Mt Fuji.
tips: Jan 20 is a Wednesday, so the south deck is open.

places.ja: 秋葉原ラジオ会館
places.blurb: 10 floors of figures, cards, model kits and anime goods opposite Akihabara Station.

info.label: Also
info.value: Akihabara ZEST (Oshi no Ko 'BEAST') is a 3 min walk north

tips: Ignore maids handing out flyers on the street; go to a real maid café.

places.ja: 麺創房 無敵家
places.blurb: A famous tonkotsu-shoyu ramen shop with thick roast pork, 3 minutes from the Ikebukuro East Exit. There is usually a queue, but it moves fast.
tips: Come at 12:45, after the office lunch peak.
Pay at the ticket machine at the door.

places.en: Ikebukuro anime goods street (Animate, Surugaya, K-BOOKS)
places.ja: 駿河屋 池袋
places.blurb: Chinese fans now call Ikebukuro the best place for anime goods. Start at the 9-floor Animate main store, then used goods at Surugaya and Lashinbang, then the row of K-BOOKS shops.

info.label: Tax-free
info.value: ¥5,000+ before tax per shop, same day

tips: Keep all receipts from one shop together for the tax refund at the airport.
Eat lunch here: many ramen shops on Sunshine 60-dori.

places.ja: 中野ブロードウェイ
places.blurb: A 1960s shopping building. Floors 2–4 are full of used figures, cards and old toys, with many Mandarake shops.
tips: Go after 13:00: small shops open late.
Many shops do not allow photos.

places.ja: 下北沢
places.blurb: The town of Bocchi the Rock!: live houses, used-clothes shops and small cafés. Walk the Bocchi spots before dark.

info.label: Bocchi spots
info.value: Honda Theater, Donguri Hiroba park, Senrogai lot

tips: Take the SHELTER stairs photo in daylight: the live house asks for no photos on show nights.
Eat dinner here before the show: soup curry is the local dish.

places.ja: 下北沢カレー食堂 茄子おやじ
places.blurb: An old Shimokitazawa curry house, known for its eggplant curry. 5 minutes on foot from SHELTER, so it is the dinner before the show.
tips: Be there at 17:30 so you leave at 18:20 for the SHELTER doors.

places.ja: 下北沢SHELTER
places.blurb: The basement live house that is the model for STARRY in Bocchi the Rock!. Tonight you go inside for a real indie rock show.

info.label: Schedule
info.value: loft-prj.co.jp, the Jan 2027 list comes out in Dec 2026

tips: Buy the ticket in December. If the site needs a Japanese phone number, pick the ticket up at a 7-Eleven or FamilyMart.
Bring ¥600 in coins for the drink ticket. Standing only.

places.ja: ドン・キホーテ 新宿東南口店
places.blurb: A 24-hour discount store on the walk from Shinjuku Station to the hotel. Pegasis buys one medium suitcase here on day 2, for the goods and the way home.

info.label: Coupon
info.value: Show the visitor coupon on your phone and your passport: tax-free + coupon

tips: A medium case is enough: a large one may pass 23 kg on the flight home.
Aoki: Chinese plugs with angled pins do not fit Japanese sockets. A travel adapter is about ¥500–1,000 here.

places.ja: トヨタレンタカー 新宿三丁目駅前店
places.blurb: A real Toyota Rent a Car shop 10 minutes on foot from the hotel. You take the car for 24 hours: the Fuji–Hakone–Daikoku day, then return it on Friday morning.

info.label: Address
info.value: Shinjuku 4-2-18, next to the Koshu-kaido overpass

info.label: Rent
info.value: Thu Jan 21 08:00 → Fri Jan 22 08:00, same shop

info.label: Licence
info.value: Toyota accepts a Geneva IDP + passport and states no minimum years (official FAQ). Aoki's licence is also valid.

info.label: Cost
info.value: Compact, 24 h: about ¥15,000–18,000 + studless tyres ¥2,200/24 h + ETC card ¥550 (estimate, check when you book)

tips: Book now (bookings open 6 months ahead) with studless tyres (スタッドレスタイヤ), then phone the shop (03-3341-2603) to confirm a studless car: Tokyo shops have few.
One-way return is possible only inside Tokyo, so this plan brings the car back here.
Tonight park in a 24 h coin car park with a daily maximum (最大料金) near the hotel, about ¥2,000–3,500.

places.ja: 河口湖 大石公園
places.blurb: The classic view of Mt Fuji across Lake Kawaguchi. Mornings are the clearest.
tips: It is below zero in the morning. Gloves and a hat.

places.ja: 御殿場プレミアム・アウトレット フードバザール
places.blurb: The food court of the outlet mall, with ramen, curry, rice bowls and a view of Fuji through the big windows.
tips: Eat first (11:35), then walk the shops: the car must leave by 12:55.

places.ja: 乙女峠
places.blurb: A mountain pass on Route 138 between Gotemba and Sengokuhara. The lookout shows Mt Fuji above the Gotemba plain.
tips: Park at the rest house car park, not on the road.

places.ja: 大観山
places.blurb: The top of the Hakone Turnpike, 1,011 m, with Lake Ashi and Mt Fuji in one view. You reach it from Sengokuhara, the valley that is Tokyo-3 in Evangelion.

info.label: Winter
info.value: Check @turn819 on X for ice or closure

tips: After the view, drive the Turnpike down to Odawara: 14 km of wide curves. If it is closed for ice, use Route 1.

places.ja: 景徳鎮
places.blurb: An old Sichuan restaurant in Yokohama Chinatown, famous for its Chen mapo tofu. All food is cooked, which suits Aoki.

info.label: Hours
info.value: Mon–Fri 11:30–22:00 (last order 21:30), weekends 11:00–22:00; no closed day (official site, Sep 26, 2026)

info.label: Cost
info.value: About ¥2,500–4,000 per person (à la carte: mapo tofu, dan dan noodles, fried rice to share)

tips: Share 3–4 dishes. Ask for mild (辛さ控えめ) if needed.
Park in a coin car park near Chinatown; no alcohol for the driver.

places.ja: 大黒PA
places.blurb: A rest area inside a giant loop of expressway ramps and the most famous JDM car meet in the world. You drive in yourselves, no guide.

info.label: Closure risk
info.value: Lower on Thu than Fri–Sat, but police now close it on some weekday nights too

tips: At 18:30 check X and the Shutoko site. If the entrance is closed, drive directly to Tatsumi 1st PA (about 35–40 min).
No revving, no burnouts. Ask before you photograph people.

places.ja: 多摩川見晴らし公園
places.blurb: The wide concrete steps on the Tama River from Girls Band Cry episode 2 and the key art.

info.label: Stamp tour
info.value: Tour place, but the park has no shop: stamps are only inside shops, in their opening hours

tips: No stamp book here: you buy it at Lazona (Shimamura Music or HMV, if they have stock) or at the Stamp Gallery after 13:00.
It is windy by the river: warm hat.

places.ja: ラゾーナ川崎プラザ ルーファ広場
places.blurb: The open-air stage in the big mall where the band plays in episode 3. The anime angle is from the 4F and 5F walkways.

info.label: Stamps
info.value: Shimamura Music and HMV Lazona Kawasaki (shop hours); they may sell the ¥500 stamp book (stock differs by shop)

tips: No photos of the stage during events: obey the signs.

places.ja: 丸福珈琲店 川崎アゼリア店
places.blurb: The old-style coffee shop in the Azalea underground mall where the Girls Band Cry band eat hotcakes. Lunch and a stamp for the stamp tour.

info.label: Cost
info.value: Hotcake + coffee about ¥1,300–1,800; sandwiches and curry also on the menu

tips: Ask for the stamp with the stamp book.
Order a sandwich or curry with the hotcake for a real lunch.

places.en: Kawasaki East Exit: plaza, Marufuku Coffee, CLUB CITTA'
places.ja: 川崎駅東口 駅前広場
places.blurb: Three Girls Band Cry places within 5 minutes: the station plaza, Marufuku Coffee in the Azalea underground mall, and the CLUB CITTA' live hall in La Cittadella.

info.label: Marufuku Coffee
info.value: 丸福珈琲店 川崎アゼリア店, 7:30–22:00, stamp spot

info.label: CLUB CITTA'
info.value: クラブチッタ, La Cittadella

info.label: GIRLS BAND CRY STAMP GALLERY
info.value: Fan shop in Kawasaki Azalea: weekdays 13:00–20:00, weekends 11:00–20:00; sells the ¥500 stamp book

tips: Have coffee and a hotcake at Marufuku, like the band.
The online shop (mirai things) ships only inside Japan, so you cannot get the stamp book at home before the trip.

places.ja: SHIBUYA SKY（渋谷スカイ）
places.blurb: An open roof deck 230 m above the Scramble crossing. Enter before 15:00 for the cheaper ticket and stay until the lights come on.
tips: Web tickets open about 2 weeks ahead (about Jan 8, Japan time). Buy the 14:40 slot.
After: Hachiko statue (Girls Band Cry ep 3), Nintendo TOKYO and Pokémon Center in Shibuya PARCO (open to 21:00), 10 min walk.

places.ja: めいどりーみん 渋谷店
places.blurb: The Shibuya shop of the maid café chain with stage shows, 8 minutes from Shibuya Sky. Dinner with a show after the sunset.

info.label: Hours
info.value: About 11:30–23:00 like the other shops (check the shop page)

info.label: Cost
info.value: ¥880 per hour + one order; about ¥2,000–3,000 with food

tips: Ignore maids handing out flyers on the street; go to the real shop.
A photo with a maid costs extra.

places.ja: 品川駅
places.blurb: The Tokaido Shinkansen stops here. From Shinjuku it is closer and less crowded than Tokyo Station.
tips: Suitcases over 160 cm total need a seat with oversized baggage space: reserve it.

places.ja: 天然温泉 朝霧の湯 ドーミーインPREMIUMなんばANNEX
places.blurb: A business hotel in Higashi-Shinsaibashi, next to the main Dormy Inn Namba. One base for all 3 Kansai nights: Nara, Kyoto and Suzuka are day trips. Laundry corner on 13F.

info.label: Price
info.value: ¥73,500–84,000 for 3 nights, 2 people (Jalan, vacancy seen Sep 26, 2026) = about ¥37,000–42,000 per person

info.label: Stations
info.value: Nippombashi and Nagahoribashi, a few minutes on foot

tips: Free late-night ramen (夜鳴きそば) 21:30–23:00 for guests.
Breakfast buffet HATAGO 2F 6:30–9:30, ¥2,500 (not in the room-only price).
Kintetsu-Nippombashi (trains to Nara) is about 8 min on foot; Nagahoribashi (Sakaisuji Line) 4 min.
The main Dormy Inn PREMIUM Namba was not on sale for these dates; the ANNEX is its sister hotel on the same block.

places.ja: 和牛武蔵 黒門店
places.blurb: A wagyu stall in Kuromon Market that grills skewers and steak pieces for you to eat on the spot. Everything is cooked, which suits Aoki.

info.label: Hours
info.value: 8:30–16:30 (Google Maps, Sep 26, 2026); a few irregular closed days each month

tips: If it is closed that day, eat at the grilled-scallop and fried-food stalls next to it.

places.en: Todai-ji Great Buddha Hall and the Nara Park deer
places.ja: 東大寺 大仏殿
places.blurb: A huge wooden hall with a 15 m bronze Buddha, at the end of a park with about 1,300 wild deer.
tips: Hold the crackers high until you are ready. Bow to a deer: it bows back.
Hide maps and snacks: the deer eat paper.

places.ja: とんかつ がんこ 奈良店
places.blurb: A tonkatsu restaurant of the Ganko chain on the Higashimuki shopping street, 5 minutes from Kintetsu-Nara. Early dinner before the hill fire.

info.label: Hours
info.value: 11:00–21:15 (last order 20:45), every day (gankofood.co.jp and Google Maps, Sep 26, 2026)

tips: Come at 16:00: after 17:00 the festival crowd fills the street.

places.en: Wakakusa hill burning, view from Kasugano (Nara Park)
places.ja: 奈良春日野国際フォーラム 甍
places.blurb: On Sat Jan 23, 2027: 600 fireworks at 18:15, then the whole grass hill of Wakakusa-yama is set on fire at 18:30. The open ground around the Kasugano forum faces the hill.

info.label: Weather
info.value: Cancelled in bad weather, no second date

tips: Be in place by 17:15. The base of the hill is packed.
Eat an early dinner before 16:45 in the Higashimuki shopping street.

places.ja: ドーミーインPREMIUMなんばANNEX 朝食会場「HATAGO」
places.romaji: Dōmī In Namba Anekkusu Chōshoku Kaijō Hatago
places.blurb: The breakfast buffet of your Namba hotel, on 2F: Osaka dishes, rice bowls you build yourself, bread and salad.

info.label: Cost
info.value: ¥2,500 per adult (buy at the front desk; cheaper if added to the room plan)

tips: Your room is 'room only': add breakfast for Jan 24 and 25 when you book if it is cheaper, or pay at the desk.
Cheaper: FamilyMart 2 minutes from the hotel (24 h).

places.ja: 伏見稲荷大社
places.blurb: Thousands of red torii gates up a forest hill. At 07:30 there are almost no people.
tips: Walk up to the Yotsutsuji crossing (about 40 min) for the city view, then turn back.

places.ja: 金閣寺
places.blurb: The gold pavilion on a pond. After a night of snow its roof is white, which happens only a few mornings each winter.
tips: Check the Kyoto snow forecast the night before.

places.en: Kyoto Concert Hall (Sabbat of the Witch school)
places.ja: 京都コンサートホール
places.blurb: The modern hall used as the school in Sabbat of the Witch. Outside photos only. You meet here at 11:15.
tips: Save the game CGs on your phone to match the angles.

places.en: Yakimeshi to Men Kyoto (ramen and fried rice)
places.ja: 焼飯と麺 京都
places.blurb: A ramen and fried-rice shop on Sanjo-dori, next to the Sanjo Meitengai arcade from Sabbat of the Witch.
tips: Come at 12:45: Sunday lunch is busy, but the queue moves fast.

places.ja: 三条名店街
places.blurb: The covered shopping arcade from the Sabbat ramen-challenge scene. Eat a Kyoto ramen lunch nearby.
tips: Keihan Sanjo, 5 min walk, has direct trains back to Osaka.

places.en: Kyoto Station (Sabbat of the Witch meeting place)
places.ja: 京都駅
places.blurb: The huge glass hall and Grand Stairway of Kyoto Station, where the Sabbat of the Witch characters meet. You come here after the Kitayama school building.

info.label: Meeting point
info.value: Central gate side, under the big glass roof (you meet at Kitayama first)

tips: Climb the Grand Stairway (大階段) for the view from the top.
From Kitayama it is 20 min on the Karasuma Line; lunch follows at Sanjo, 2 stops north.

places.ja: 日本橋でんでんタウン・オタロード
places.blurb: Osaka's Akihabara: Super Potato for retro games, Animate, Melonbooks and used figure shops on one side street.
tips: Used goods are often cheaper than in Akihabara.
Maidreamin and CCOちゃ maid cafés are on Otaroad if you want a second maid café.

places.ja: 千房 道頓堀ビル店
places.blurb: A well-known Osaka okonomiyaki chain in the middle of Dotonbori. The staff cook it at your table.

info.label: Hours
info.value: 11:00–23:00, every day (chibo.com and Google Maps, Sep 26, 2026)

info.label: Cost
info.value: Okonomiyaki ¥1,480–1,980; about ¥2,500–3,000 per person with a drink

tips: After dinner walk to the Glico sign and Ura-Namba; takoyaki from a stall if you are still hungry.

places.en: Suzuka Circuit (EV kart on the F1 course)
places.ja: 鈴鹿サーキット
places.blurb: The Japanese F1 Grand Prix track. In the park anyone can drive an EV kart on the real East Course, no licence needed.

info.label: Mon Jan 25
info.value: 10:00–16:30, entry ¥2,000 (official calendar, seen Sep 26, 2026; web tickets about ¥500 less)

info.label: EV kart
info.value: Circuit Challenger on the East Course, ¥2,000 per kart (2 seats), web tickets only (Asoview). In late January it runs only about 12:00–13:15 (Jan 2026: 12:25–13:05)

info.label: Access
info.value: Kintetsu Urban Liner to Shiroko, then Mie Kotsu (Sanco) bus 'Shiroko Circuit Line' (weekdays to the circuit 09:40, 10:20; back 13:10, 15:10, 17:00, 17:45; ¥500) or taxi about 20 min

tips: The January kart times come out on Dec 1, 2026: book two karts (one each) for about 12:30.
Walk to the grandstand and look at the pit straight.

places.en: Putti Town Kitchen, Suzuka Circuit park
places.ja: プッチタウンキッチン（鈴鹿サーキット）
places.blurb: A family restaurant inside the Suzuka Circuit park: curry, pasta, rice bowls.
tips: Eat at 11:45, then walk to the East Course for the kart at about 12:30.

places.en: Liberty Walk JDM PARK / LB DRIVE-IN
places.ja: JDM PARK / LB DRIVE-IN
places.blurb: Liberty Walk's showroom of wide-body cars, goods shop and café in Sennan, south of Osaka.
tips: Check the hours on Instagram the day before.
Taxi from Izumisano Station about 15 min; ask the shop to call a taxi back.

places.ja: さのちり亭
places.blurb: A local izakaya with fish hot pot (chirinabe) and grilled dishes, 2 minutes from Izumisano Station. Dinner after Liberty Walk.
tips: Aoki: ask for cooked dishes (nabe, karaage, yakitori).

places.ja: 南海なんば駅
places.blurb: The Rapi:t airport train to Kansai Airport starts here.

info.label: Rapi:t
info.value: Rapi:t α 5, Namba 07:00 → KIX 07:34, ¥1,670 with reserved seat

tips: Buy Rapi:t seats online the day before.

places.ja: 関西国際空港
places.blurb: Jetstar to New Chitose leaves from Terminal 1.

info.label: Flight
info.value: Jetstar Japan GK 153, Kansai 10:05 → New Chitose 12:05, Tue Jan 26 (Sep 2026 schedule; Google Flights showed ¥7,510 for a 09:50 departure: check the time when you book)

tips: Aoki and Pegasis: buy a checked bag each when you book (about ¥2,500 each); later it costs more.
Jetstar allows 7 kg of cabin bags in total: Pegasis's thick coat and boots are worn on the plane.
Be at the counter by 08:45.

places.en: Cafe & Bar Wa SAKURA, KIX Terminal 1
places.ja: Cafe＆Bar 和SAKURA 関西国際空港第1ターミナルビル2F店
places.blurb: A café in Terminal 1, 2F: sandwiches, rice dishes and coffee. Breakfast after the bag drop.
tips: Drop the bags first (the Jetstar counter opens about 2 h before the flight).

places.ja: 新千歳空港
places.blurb: Hokkaido's main airport. You land here on Jan 26 and both fly home from here on Feb 2.

info.label: Rental cars
info.value: Counters in the domestic arrivals hall, shuttle to the shops

tips: Jan 26: lunch at Ebisoba Ichigen in the Hokkaido Ramen Dojo (3F, domestic terminal) before you pick up the car.
Feb 2: Aoki uses the international terminal (10 min walk through the corridor). Do the tax-free customs check before bag drop.
Feb 2: Pegasis can put the suitcase in a coin locker until the Air Canada counter opens (about 3 h before the flight).

places.ja: えびそば一幻 新千歳空港店
places.blurb: A famous Sapporo ramen shop with a rich shrimp broth, in the Hokkaido Ramen Dojo on the 3rd floor of the domestic terminal.

info.label: Hours
info.value: 9:00–21:00 (last order 20:00), every day (New Chitose Airport site and Google Maps, Sep 26, 2026)

tips: Choose the broth: 'sou' (strong shrimp) or 'hodohodo' (mild).
Queues are short before 12:00.

places.en: Toyota Rent a Car New Chitose Airport Poplar
places.ja: トヨタレンタカー 新千歳空港ポプラ店
places.blurb: Check in at the rental counter in the arrivals hall, then a free 9-min shuttle to the shop. Studless tyres are standard in Hokkaido.

info.label: Rent
info.value: Tue Jan 26 about 13:00 → Sat Jan 30 about 13:15, return at Sapporo-ekimae (one-way inside Hokkaido is allowed)

info.label: Car
info.value: Compact 4WD, studless tyres (standard in Hokkaido), ETC card

tips: Pegasis: licence + IDP + passport. Aoki can drive too.
Ask about the one-way fee to Sapporo-ekimae when you book.

places.ja: ニセコノーザンリゾート・アンヌプリ
places.blurb: A ski-in, ski-out hotel at the foot of the Annupuri slopes, with a dinner and breakfast buffet of Hokkaido food and big snow views. You sleep here 4 nights: this is the plan's special stay.

info.label: Room
info.value: Deluxe twin, 30 m², own bath and toilet (a Hollywood twin: two 110 cm beds side by side; ask for the standard twin if you want separate beds)

info.label: Plan
info.value: Official site, 90-day early-bird plan, dinner + breakfast buffet

info.label: Price
info.value: ¥282,600 for 4 nights, 2 people (official site, Sep 26, 2026, 90-day plan, "1 room left"; ¥288,400 on the 60-day plan; Jalan ¥303,808) = about ¥35,300 per person per night

info.label: Ski
info.value: Ski lockers with direct access to the Annupuri slopes; own ski rental shop

info.label: Tax
info.value: Niseko town tax (a % of the room price from Nov 1, 2026) + Hokkaido tax, paid at the hotel: about ¥1,000 per person per night (estimate)

tips: Book this now on the official site (90-day early-bird needs booking by about Oct 28); it showed '1 room left'.
The hotel has an onsen and a sauna; nobody has to use them. The room has its own bath.
Laundry night 3 is here, in the hotel coin laundry (Jan 28).

places.ja: リズム ヒラフ
places.blurb: Niseko's biggest rental shop, 100 m from the Grand Hirafu gondola. You both rent skis, boots, poles, helmet, and ski jacket and pants here, and buy goggles and gloves in its shop.

info.label: 3 days, all of it
info.value: About ¥46,000 per person, about ¥41,000 with the online discount

info.label: Not for rent
info.value: Goggles and gloves (hygiene rule): buy them in the Rhythm retail shop (goggles about ¥5,000–15,000, gloves ¥4,000–10,000)

tips: Book online by Oct 31, 2026: the 10% online discount (code on the Rhythm site) ends that day. You cannot pick brands online; the fitting is in the shop.
Pick-up Wed Jan 27 about 08:35 (3-day rental Jan 27–29); return on Fri Jan 29 about 15:40, at the end of the Hirafu day.
Rhythm also has a free pick-up shuttle from Annupuri on the first rental day (phone 20–30 min before).

places.ja: ニセコアンヌプリ国際スキー場
places.blurb: The quieter side of Niseko, with wide gentle runs. The best place in Niseko for a beginner, and powder for a good skier.

info.label: Beginner area
info.value: Family course (580 m, max 11°) and Paradise course, from the short Dream No.1 Quad lift (433 m, 4 min)

info.label: Tickets 2026-27 peak
info.value: 1 day ¥7,800, 5 hours ¥6,700, 4-point ticket ¥2,660 (Dream Quad = 1 point a ride)

tips: First hours for Aoki: buy the 4-point ticket (4 rides on the Dream Quad) instead of a day ticket.
Stay on green runs. Do not enter Strawberry Fields or go left off the marked runs.
Check the course map at the base: lifts and courses can change with the snow.

places.ja: ヌックアンヌプリ
places.blurb: The base building of Annupuri, 3 minutes from the hotel: tonkatsu, katsu curry and rice bowls, with a rental shop and lockers.

info.label: Hours
info.value: About 11:00–16:00 (Google Maps; winter hours not yet on the official site)

tips: Eat at 12:00 before the ski-school groups come in.

places.ja: ルスツリゾートスキー場
places.blurb: A big ski resort with long groomed runs and far fewer people than Niseko, next to the drift course.

info.label: Ticket 2026-27
info.value: No afternoon ticket. 5 hours ¥14,500 (¥11,600 online), or point tickets ¥800 a point

tips: Aoki: stay on the easy runs near the base.
Buy the 5-hour ticket online the day before for the lower price.

places.en: Daniel Street Salad & Deli, Rusutsu Resort Hotel
places.ja: ダニエルストリート サラダ＆デリ（ルスツリゾートホテル）
places.blurb: A deli in the Rusutsu Resort Hotel (South Wing 1F), in the same building as the Activity Desk for the snow drift course.

info.label: Hours
info.value: 11:00–17:00, every day (rusutsu.com dining page and Google Maps, Sep 26, 2026)

tips: Eat here at 12:30, then go to the Activity Desk at 14:30 in the same hotel.

places.ja: ルスツリゾート 雪上ドリフト
places.blurb: A closed snow course with Subaru, GT-R and GR Yaris cars. Ride with a pro rally driver or drive yourself with an instructor beside you.

info.label: Introduction course (drive yourself, 30 min)
info.value: ¥31,000, only at 15:00; 1 passenger in the rear seat ¥10,000 (max 2 per car)

info.label: Booking
info.value: By 17:00 the day before; prepaid; 10% cancellation fee from booking, 50% from the day before

info.label: Licence
info.value: A driver's licence must be shown; foreign licence + IDP and minimum years not stated: email first

tips: Check in at the Activity Desk in the Rusutsu Resort Hotel 20–30 min early. There is a breath test.
Pegasis: email activity@rusutsu.co.jp now to confirm a 1-year licence + IDP is accepted. If not, both take the pro ride (¥17,000 each).
Warm shoes you can feel the pedals in.

places.ja: ニセコ東急 グラン・ヒラフ
places.blurb: The biggest part of Niseko United, with Mt Yotei across the valley. On Friday you both drive over: the Family course for Aoki, the upper lifts for Pegasis.

info.label: Beginner area
info.value: Family course from the Ace Family Quad No.1; Holiday course from the King Holiday Pair lift

info.label: Parking
info.value: Welcome Center car park (fee not confirmed)

tips: Only go off-piste through the official gates.
Aoki: stay on the Family and Holiday courses.

places.ja: パウダーフッド レストラン＆タップルーム
places.blurb: A restaurant at the Ace Gondola base in Grand Hirafu: burgers, pizza, rice dishes. Close to the Family course.

info.label: Hours
info.value: 10:30–23:00 (Google Maps, Sep 26, 2026; winter hours not yet on its own site)

tips: Go at 12:00; the resort is busy at 12:30.

places.ja: スープカレー GARAKU
places.blurb: Sapporo's own dish: a thin, spicy curry soup with big chicken and grilled vegetables. One of the most popular shops.

info.label: Address
info.value: Minami 3-jo Higashi 2-chome 6-1, Presant bldg B1F (east of the Sosei river)

info.label: Hours
info.value: Lunch 11:30–15:30 (last order 15:00), closed some days without a fixed rule

tips: Take a number from the machine at the door, then wait nearby (Nijo Market and Tanukikoji 7-chome are 5 min on foot).
Park in a coin car park near Minami 3 Higashi 2.

places.ja: トヨタレンタカー 札幌駅前店
places.blurb: Return the Hokkaido car here, east of JR Sapporo Station, 10 min on foot from the hotel.
tips: Fill the tank first.
One-way fee from New Chitose: check when you book.

places.ja: ホテルルートイン札幌駅前北口
places.romaji: Hoteru Rūto In Sapporo Ekimae Kitaguchi
places.blurb: A good-value business hotel on the north side of Sapporo Station, with a public bath and a free breakfast buffet. Trains to Asahikawa and the airport leave 5 minutes away. You sleep here 3 nights.

info.label: Price
info.value: ¥78,400 for 3 nights, 2 people (Jalan, Sep 26, 2026) = about ¥39,200 per person

tips: Laundry night 4 (Jan 31) is in the hotel coin laundry.
Susukino and Daruma are 15 min by the Namboku subway line.
Free breakfast buffet 6:30–9:00.

places.ja: もいわ山
places.blurb: A ropeway and mini cable car to a deck with all of Sapporo below. Come for sunset and stay for the lights.
tips: Tram to Ropeway-iriguchi, then the free shuttle bus to the base.

places.ja: 成吉思汗だるま 本店
places.blurb: Sapporo's most famous lamb barbecue since 1954: you grill lamb and onions on a dome-shaped pan at the counter.

info.label: Hours
info.value: 17:00–05:00 (not confirmed: check Google Maps the week before)

tips: There is almost always a queue: be there by 17:45.
Your coats will smell of lamb: they give bags.

places.ja: 札幌駅
places.blurb: JR hub for Asahikawa and the airport.

info.label: To Asahikawa
info.value: Limited Express Lilac/Kamui, 1 h 25, ¥5,440 with reserved seat

tips: Reserve the Asahikawa seats at the JR ticket office the day before.

places.ja: 旭川駅
places.blurb: Buses to Asahiyama Zoo leave from bus stop 6 in front of the station.

info.label: Bus to zoo
info.value: Asahikawa Denki Kido bus 41/47 from stop 6, about 40 min, ¥670; no Suica (only Asaca/DoCARD): buy tickets at the stop 6 machine with cash or credit card

places.ja: 旭山動物園
places.blurb: In winter, king penguins walk a 500 m loop through the snow between the visitors. Also polar bears and a tunnel under the penguin pool.
tips: Stand on the route by 10:40 for a front place.

places.ja: ラーメンの蜂屋 五条創業店
places.blurb: Asahikawa shoyu ramen since 1947, with a pork-and-fish soup and burnt lard on top.

info.label: Hours
info.value: 10:30–19:50 (not confirmed: check Google Maps the week before)

tips: Ask for less burnt lard (少なめ) if you want it milder.

places.en: Nemuro Hanamaru, JR Tower Stellar Place
places.ja: 回転寿司根室花まる JRタワーステラプレイス店
places.romaji: Kaiten-zushi Nemuro Hanamaru JR Tawā Suteraplēsu-ten
places.blurb: A popular conveyor-belt sushi chain from east Hokkaido, in the mall above Sapporo Station. Good fish at low prices; there are cooked plates too (tamago, fried chicken, miso soup, grilled fish).
tips: Take a number from the machine at 16:40, right after the train; the wait can be 60 min or more.
Aoki: ask for the cooked plates (炙り, 玉子, 唐揚げ).

places.ja: らーめん吉山商店街
places.blurb: A Sapporo miso ramen shop (roasted sesame miso) on Tanukikoji 5-chome, inside the covered arcade.

places.ja: 狸小路・まんだらけ札幌店
places.blurb: Sapporo's covered shopping street with Mandarake and other anime goods shops, dry in the snow.
tips: Covered arcade: good on a snowy day.
Buy souvenirs here; the suitcase is in the hotel.

places.ja: めいどりーみん 札幌狸小路店
places.blurb: The same maid show as Akihabara, in the covered Tanukikoji arcade. Open until 23:00.
tips: The last night out: Pegasis's maid café want, Aoki's maybe.

places.ja: 松尾ジンギスカン 新千歳空港店
places.blurb: Hokkaido's best-known marinated lamb barbecue, in the domestic terminal 3F food area. A last Hokkaido lunch together.
tips: Aoki: the international terminal is a 10-min walk through the connecting corridor; be at the Spring Airlines counter by 11:30.

places.ja: 千歳・支笏湖氷濤まつり
places.blurb: Walk-through ice caves and towers made from blue lake water. Opens Jan 30, 2027.

info.label: Bus
info.value: Hokkaido Chuo Bus from New Chitose Airport, weekdays 12:35 → Shikotsu-ko 13:32 (¥1,260); back 15:45 → airport about 16:45 (summer 2026 timetable; check the winter one in January)

tips: Take the direct airport bus, not the bus from Chitose Station. If the times change, skip it and eat at the airport: the flight is more important.

places.en: Kantaro conveyor-belt sushi, New Chitose Airport
places.ja: グルメ回転寿司 函太郎 新千歳空港店
places.blurb: Hakodate conveyor-belt sushi in the domestic terminal: a last Hokkaido seafood dinner for Pegasis before the evening flight.
tips: Eat at 17:00, then check in when Air Canada opens (about 16:35–17:00).

days.title: Land at Narita, meet at Terminal 3, first late dinner in Omoide Yokocho
days.titleJa: 成田空港（第3ターミナル）→ 東京駅 丸の内南口ドーム → 新宿 → 思い出横丁
days.romaji: Narita Kūkō → Tōkyō Eki → Shinjuku → Omoide Yokochō
days.summary: Pegasis lands first and waits for Aoki at Terminal 3 with an early meal. You take the airport bus together, stop 10 minutes under the Girls Band Cry dome at Tokyo Station, and end the day with cheap food in Omoide Yokocho.
alerts: Both: fill in Visit Japan Web before the flight.
Aoki: Spring Airlines fare with a checked bag (the cheapest fare has a small cabin bag only).
Pegasis: take the free terminal shuttle bus to Terminal 3 and wait there; do not go ahead alone.

stops.note: Pegasis lands at Terminal 1 (WestJet WS 80). Immigration and customs, then the free shuttle bus to Terminal 3.
Pegasis: early dinner (beef bowl, about ¥700), buy two Welcome Suica cards, then wait at T3 arrivals. Aoki lands 18:40 (Spring Airlines 9C 6217) and is out at about 19:25.
Together: Girls Band Cry ep 1, Nina arrives under this dome. 10 minutes.
Check in.
Dinner: small plates of yakitori, stew and a drink at the standing bar (closes 23:00). Short night.

legs.label: Narita free terminal shuttle bus, Terminal 1 → Terminal 3 (about every 7 min, about 17:30)
Airport Bus TYO-NRT, Narita Terminal 3 19:40 → Tokyo Station Yaesu 20:48 (¥1,500; next bus 19:50 → 20:58), then walk through the station to the Marunouchi South dome
JR Chuo Line rapid (for Ome), Tokyo 21:06 → Shinjuku 21:20, then walk 10 min
Walk west under the JR tracks
Walk back through Kabukicho

days.sleepNote: Super Hotel Shinjuku Kabukicho, night 1 of 4
notes: Breakfast and lunch are on the flights (Pegasis: WestJet meals; Aoki: lunch before the 15:00 flight in Shanghai). Dinner: Pegasis eats early at Matsuya T3, both eat again at Omoide Yokocho.
Pegasis flies in wearing his own thick winter clothes (Canadian winter): there is no clothes shopping on this trip.
Buy a Japan eSIM before the flight, or a SIM at Narita. Canadian plugs fit Japanese sockets.
If Aoki is not out of customs by 19:35, take the 19:50 bus (Tokyo 20:58) and the 21:18 Chuo rapid.

days.title: Your Name stairs, Akihabara, Ikebukuro and Nakano goods, a live show at SHELTER
days.titleJa: 須賀神社 → 都庁 → 秋葉原 → 池袋 → 中野 → 下北沢SHELTER → ドン・キホーテ
days.romaji: Suga Jinja → Tochō → Akihabara → Ikebukuro → Nakano → Shimokitazawa
days.summary: After the free hotel breakfast you see the Your Name stairs and look for Fuji from the free City Hall deck, then spend the day in the three big anime-goods areas. At dusk you walk the Bocchi places in Shimokitazawa, eat curry and stand inside SHELTER for a real live show; on the way home Pegasis buys his suitcase at Don Quijote.
alerts: SHELTER ticket bought in December (show list out in Dec 2026; OPEN 18:30 / START 19:00, about ¥3,000 + drink).
Bring passports for tax-free shopping.

stops.note: Breakfast: free buffet in the hotel (7:00–9:00). Leave at 08:20.
Your Name stairs before other people come. 20 minutes.
Free view from 202 m (south deck opens 9:30). Look for Fuji to the west.
Figures and cards, top floor down. ZEST (Oshi no Ko) is 3 min north.
Lunch: tonkotsu ramen with thick roast pork.
Animate main store, Surugaya, Lashinbang, K-BOOKS. Leave at 14:25.
Mandarake floors 2–4: old figures and cards.
Bocchi spots at dusk: SHELTER stairs, Honda Theater, Donguri park.
Dinner: Shimokitazawa curry before the show. Leave at 18:20.
Doors open. Stand inside STARRY's real live house. The show ends about 21:15.
Pegasis buys a medium suitcase for the goods and the way home (about ¥5,000–10,000, tax-free with passport). 20 minutes.
Put today's goods into the suitcase.

legs.label: Walk 8 min to Shinjuku-sanchome, Tokyo Metro Marunouchi Line 08:32 → Yotsuya-sanchome 08:35, walk 7 min
Walk 7 min, Tokyo Metro Marunouchi Line (for Ogikubo) Yotsuya-sanchome 09:25 → Nishi-Shinjuku 09:32, walk 8 min
Walk 12 min to Shinjuku, JR Chuo-Sobu Line local (for Chiba) Shinjuku 10:25 → Akihabara 10:43, walk 3 min
JR Yamanote Line (inner loop, via Ueno) Akihabara 12:13 → Ikebukuro 12:33, walk 5 min from the East Exit
Walk along Sunshine 60-dori to Animate
JR Saikyo Line Ikebukuro 14:35 → Shinjuku 14:41, JR Chuo Line Ome special rapid Shinjuku 14:48 → Nakano 14:52, walk 5 min
JR Chuo Line rapid Nakano 16:02 → Shinjuku 16:06, Odakyu Line rapid express (for Fujisawa) Shinjuku 16:10 → Shimokitazawa 16:17
Walk
Walk
Odakyu Line rapid express Shimokitazawa 21:30 → Shinjuku 21:38, walk 5 min to the East Exit
Walk through Kabukicho

days.sleepNote: Super Hotel Shinjuku Kabukicho, night 2 of 4
notes: Suga stairs are Aoki's want (Pegasis marked them 'not interested'); it is only 20 minutes and on the way to City Hall, so you go together. City Hall, Nakano, Radio Kaikan and SHELTER are wants of both.
Nakano's small shops open about 12:00, so it comes after lunch.
Standing only at SHELTER; bring ¥600 in coins for the drink ticket.
SHELTER: the January 2027 list is not out yet (December). If there is no show on Wed Jan 20, swap this day with day 4, or go to another Shimokitazawa live house (DAISY BAR, 251).

days.title: Fuji, the Hakone passes, then Daikoku by night
days.titleJa: 新宿 → 河口湖 → 御殿場 → 乙女峠 → 大観山 → 横浜中華街 → 大黒PA
days.romaji: Shinjuku → Kawaguchiko → Gotenba → Otome Tōge → Taikanzan → Yokohama → Daikoku PA
days.summary: One rental car loop: Fuji across Lake Kawaguchi in the clear morning, lunch at the Gotemba outlets, Otome Pass and the Turnpike from Taikanzan in daylight. Sichuan dinner in Yokohama Chinatown, then Pegasis drives into Daikoku PA on a Thursday night, when police closures are least likely.
alerts: Studless tyres and ETC card booked with the car (book now, then phone the shop to confirm studless).
Check @turn819 on X for Turnpike ice or closure before 13:00; if closed, use Route 1. Leave Taikanzan by 14:30.
At 18:30 check X and the Shutoko site for a Daikoku closure; if closed, drive to Tatsumi 1st PA directly.

stops.note: Breakfast: free buffet (opens 7:00). Leave at 07:45.
Pick up the car at 08:00 (shop opens 08:00): licence + IDP + passports. Leave by 08:10.
Fuji across the lake, clearest in the morning. 30 min.
Lunch in the outlet food court with a Fuji view, then about 40 min in the shops (Pegasis's want). Leave by 12:55.
